messages:
jess_support: Customer (AcmeMedia) opened an ISO27001 evidence escalation — they exported audit logs but the file only contains 90 days of data while our public retention is 365d. During export they saw intermittent 401s on POST /v1/audit/export and a billing spike. Need triage, repro steps, and auditor artefacts. @maria_compliance @sam_eng

maria_compliance: Can you paste the export request IDs, time range, and any console screenshots? Auditors will want chain-of-custody + KMS provenance.

jess_support: Request IDs: req_7b9f2c, req_7b9f8d. Time range requested: 2024-11-01 to 2025-11-01. Customer used console export then API: POST /v1/audit/export {"tenant":"acme-prod","from":"2024-11-01","to":"2025-11-01"}. Screenshot shows S3 file with 90d.

sam_eng: Quick check plan: 1) tenant-level retention overrides (legacy migration) 2) export job runner's query window (fallback if manifest missing). @lee_sre can you check config-store for tenant.retention_days for acme-prod?

lee_sre: Querying config store... found tenant.acme-prod.retention_days = 90 (set during migration 2023-06-12). That explains the 90d export.

maria_compliance: If retention was intentionally changed we need the change request. If accidental, we must document remediation and notify auditors.

jess_support: Customer says they never requested 90d. Support history shows no SR for retention change. @infra-bot did automated migration touch tenant configs in 2023-06?

infra-bot: deploy-batch-2023-06 applied migration 'tenant-retention-normalize' on 2023-06-12. Migration defaulted missing 'retention_days' to 90d for ~50 tenants.

sam_eng: Migration default explains it. Action: backfill affected tenants and add validation so migrations cannot silently lower retention. Also confirm export API enforces tenant.retention_days server-side.

jess_support: Next item: the intermittent 401s. Customer trace IDs: trace-9a1, trace-9a2 (occurred 2025-02-14T15:02Z).

lee_sre: Auth logs show transient KMS key access latency. Vendor HSM (vendor-hsm-1) reported maintenance 2025-02-14T14:55-15:05 UTC. During that window auth middleware retried; some requests returned 401 before token refresh completed.

security-bot: HSM rotation started 2025-02-14 14:50 UTC (staged). There was a short cache invalidation window that could cause auth middleware failures. Incident ticket INC-4901 created.

maria_compliance: For ISO evidence we'll need exact timestamps, rotation justification, KMS access logs, and the rotation operator identity.

sam_eng: Action items: A) Backfill tenant.acme-prod.retention_days -> 365 and re-run export B) Bundle auditor package: export manifest, KMS access logs, rotation record C) Reproduce export and capture request/response headers + trace IDs. I'll run a canary and post artifacts.

jess_support: Customer also reported a billing spike from the duplicate exports. @nate_billing any notes?

nate_billing: Billing shows duplicate export jobs billed due to client retries after 401; dedupe logic didn't catch retry-generated job_ids. We issued a one-time credit for duplicates on 2025-02-15. Reference billing_adj_554 / credit memo CM-2025-022.

jess_support: Confirm refund posted to AcmeMedia and add credit memo to auditor zip.

nate_billing: Refund posted 2025-02-15, credit memo CM-2025-022 attached to account.

sam_eng: Repro steps (I'll run in 30m):
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acme-prod","from":"2024-11-01","to":"2025-11-01"}'
2) poll /v1/jobs/{job_id} until status=completed
3) fetch S3 link and verify object header 'x-retention-days' == 365
4) capture trace id from response headers and include job_id and final S3 path
I'll post artifacts when done.

lee_sre: Backfill scheduled: config-store:update tenant.acme-prod.retention_days=365 and requeue export. ETA ~2h.

maria_compliance: I'll assemble an auditor package: manifest.json, export-raw.ndjson.gz, kms-access.log (2025-02-14T14:50-15:15), rotation_record.pdf, billing_credit_CM-2025-022.pdf. Will upload to secure share and provide access to auditor.

jess_support: Great. I'll update customer with ETA and tell auditors we will provide full provenance + refund.

sam_eng: Logs: original req_7b9f8d returned 401 at 2025-02-14T15:02Z trace=trace-9a2; retry req_7b9f8d-1 completed 2025-02-14T15:09Z trace=trace-9a2b. Backfill export completed 2025-02-14T17:50Z s3://redwood-exports/acme-prod/audit-20241101-20251101.ndjson.gz x-retention-days:365

maria_compliance: Draft auditor ZIP contents prepared and uploaded to secure share: manifest.json, export-raw.ndjson.gz, kms-access.log, rotation_record.pdf, billing_credit_CM-2025-022.pdf. Share link provided to customer auditors.

jess_support: Closing checklist: backfill applied, export re-run, credit issued, auditor package shared, runbook PR opened. Will close support ticket after customer confirms receipt. Keeping ISO thread open until auditor sign-off. /cc @maria_compliance

lee_sre: PR opened for migration validation & audit: github.com/redwood/infrascripts/pull/482. Owner: @lee_sre. Prod fix ETA 48h.

nate_billing: Customer notified and credit posted. :white_check_mark:

jess_support: Thanks everyone — marking resolved on support side, will update when auditor signs off.
